**PotentialKits 1.1.1**

- **MP3 sounds.** MP3 files in your sound folders are found and played like WAV and AIFF. When you export a kit, an MP3 pad is saved as a WAV beside the program, because the MPC loads WAVs there.
- Everything else is as in 1.1.0 (the SAVE and LOCK fixes and the simpler pages).

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialKits-1.1.1-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC. Unzip and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive.
- **`PotentialKits-1.1.1-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (what MPC TOOLS installs).
- **`PotentialKits-1.1.1-mpc-armv7.zip`** / **`-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: for the Open MPC installer and Plugin Manager (Gen1 / Gen2).

Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialkits/issues/new/choose).
